title: Front-Loaded First Installment on an Additional Business Security Deposit
content:
The installment paid first on an additional amount owed on a business Security Deposit is front-loaded on a weak record when the amount is spread.

**Regular installment.** The additional amount due divided by the number of installments of the plan, rounded down to the cent.

**Rule.** Records are read on the secured Electric Service Agreement for the 12 months ending on the payment date.

| Record in the 12 months | Plan has more than one installment | Installment paid first |
|---|---|---|
| A disconnection notice was issued on the secured agreement | Yes | 2 times the regular installment |
| No disconnection notice, and at least one late payment charge is counted after deducting one for each courtesy late-charge waiver credit | Yes | 1.5 times the regular installment |
| Any other record, or a plan of one installment | Either | The regular installment |

## Cases (hypothetical plan: regular installment USD 700.00 over 4 installments)

| Notices in the 12 months | Late payment charges posted | Courtesy waiver credits | Installment paid first (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 1400.00 |
| 0 | 2 | 1 | 1050.00 |
| 0 | 1 | 1 | 700.00 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 700.00 |

For a plan of one installment, the installment paid first is the regular installment whatever the record shows.
